# Third-party promotional badge

`itunes-store-badge.svg` is the unmodified Apple-provided Buy on iTunes Store badge, exported to PNG for Android without altering its artwork. It is not Yono Music's logo. Apple marks remain Apple's property and are used only next to the promoted store content and direct store links.

Official source/guidelines: https://www.apple.com/itunes/marketing-on-itunes/identity-guidelines.html
Archive: https://www.apple.com/105/media/us/ipoditunes/itunes/2018/3a5387c5_1ebd_4993_9633_ff7264dc27bf/itunes-store-badges/us_uk.zip
Member: US_UK/iTunes_Store_Badge/Buy_on/SVG/US_UK_iTunes_Store_Buy_Badge_RGB_011818.svg
Usage: https://performance-partners.apple.com/search-api

The Apple badge/marks are not relicensed under the application's open-source license. No preview audio or remote album-cover runtime assets are bundled. Documentation screenshots show the actual catalogue UI during verification. Apple previews are streamed for individual store discovery, not exported, saved, auto-playlisted or used to promote another service's downloads.
